//: Illustrative config, not executed by this repo. It documents the field
paths from a real, published 1322 API contract (Binance Square,
https://1322.io/docs, WsEnvelope / BinancePost types) purely to show
how the generic adapter's field-mapping shape works in practice.
This is here as a worked example of a feed that DOES expose an explicit
content's own publish time (BinancePost.published_at) - contrast with
the 1322 X/Twitter feed (see src/adapters/x1322.ts), which does not.
Before pointing this at a live Binance Square (or any other) endpoint:
- Re-verify the exact WS event `type` string(s) against a live
GET /v1/dashboard response and the current docs - the docs page's
connection-example snippet and its formal WsEnvelope type did not
agree on this at the time this example was written, so do not trust
the placeholder type value below without checking a live message.
- Confirm auth: X-Api-Key header, ws key via query param `key=`.
- Get your own API key; this repo ships no credentials and has not
run this config against any live service.
name: binance-square-1322-illustrative
//wsUrl: Only {API_KEY} is a substituted token. Replace YOUR_WS_PATH_FROM_DASHBOARD yourself - the path is per-account and comes from GET /v1/dashboard, this tool does not fetch it for you.
